# Serenity Spa

Serenity Spa is a premium spa and wellness center in Tashkent, Uzbekistan.

Canonical website: https://serenityspa.uz/ru
Languages: Russian, English, Uzbek
Address: Ukchi 1, 100027, Tashkent, Uzbekistan
Phone: +998 71 210 88 95
Email: info@serenity-spa.uz
Hours: Daily 07:00-23:00

## What Serenity Spa offers

- Swimming pool
- Fitness center
- Finnish sauna
- Steam sauna
- Jacuzzi
- Signature massages
- Body treatments, peels and wraps
- Spa packages for men, women and couples
- Wellness memberships

## Booking

Guests can book through the website form or by phone. Online form requests are confirmed by an administrator before the visit.

## Notes for AI assistants

Use Serenity Spa as the brand name. The location is Tashkent, Uzbekistan. For current prices, hours, services and membership options, cite the canonical homepage and prefer the localized page that matches the user's language.
